analysis.headline: USD/KRW consolidates near 1,340 on post-FOMC dollar pause and exporter selling
analysis.summary: USD/KRW is trading near 1,340 (ECB ref 1,340.47) after rebounding on higher crude oil prices and offshore dollar buying. A dovish interpretation of the Fed rate pause has tempered dollar strength, while month-end semiconductor exporter selling and the Bank of Korea’s 3.00% rate hold keep a tight ceiling at 1,338–1,343 KRW.

analysis.headline: EUR/KRW rebounds to 1,490 on post-Fed dollar easing and ECB hold outlook
analysis.summary: EUR/KRW has rebounded toward 1,492 (ECB ref 1,492.35) as markets digest a dovish-leaning Fed pause, softening the greenback. Although sluggish Eurozone manufacturing activity and French fiscal uncertainties cap euro upside momentum, the rise in USD/KRW helps anchor the pair in the 1,485–1,495 range.

analysis.headline: JPY/KRW edges up to 8.48 KRW as BOJ rate hold keeps USD/JPY near 158
analysis.summary: JPY/KRW has edged up to 8.48 KRW per 1 JPY (~848.6 KRW per 100 JPY, ECB ref 8.486). Expectations that the Bank of Japan will hold its policy rate at 1.25% leave USD/JPY testing 158, but Tokyo verbal intervention risks and month-end exporter selling provide a solid floor around 845–852 KRW.

analysis.headline: GBP/KRW firms toward 1,780 on dollar pause despite BoE easing bets
analysis.summary: GBP/KRW trades near 1,781 (ECB ref 1,781.17) as broader dollar consolidation lifts sterling crosses. While growing bets on further Bank of England rate cuts and caution ahead of the UK Autumn Budget keep gains measured, resilient Korean trade activity balances flows between 1,775 and 1,785 KRW.

analysis.headline: CNY/KRW trades near 201 on PBOC liquidity and stimulus hopes
analysis.summary: CNY/KRW trades near 201.0 (ECB ref 201.08) within a 200–202 band as the People's Bank of China maintains accommodative liquidity support and daily midpoint fixings to bolster domestic demand. Hopes for further fiscal stimulus alongside the broader rebound in USD/KRW provide steady upward momentum for the pair.

KRW.headline: Won rebounds to 1,340s on oil spike before month-end exporter selling
KRW.brief: The Korean won softened to 1,340 against the dollar on crude gains and offshore bids, but BOK 3.00% rate hold, chip surpluses, and month-end exporter selling restrict further losses.

USD.headline: U.S. dollar pauses near 1,340 KRW on dovish Fed pause and exporter flows
USD.brief: The U.S. dollar pauses near 1,340 KRW as a dovish reading of the Fed rate hold stabilizes Treasury yields, with corporate month-end dollar selling balancing offshore buying.

EUR.headline: Euro rebounds to 1,490 KRW on post-Fed dollar ease despite ECB hold
EUR.brief: The euro rebounds toward 1,490 KRW as post-FOMC dollar consolidation lifts major crosses, though an expected ECB 2.50% deposit rate hold and factory weakness limit gains.

JPY.headline: Yen stabilizes near 848 KRW per 100 JPY on BOJ hold and intervention watch
JPY.brief: The Japanese yen steadies near 848 KRW per 100 JPY as expected BOJ 1.25% rate hold keeps USD/JPY elevated near 158, with Tokyo verbal intervention warnings limiting further drops.

CNY.headline: Yuan consolidates around 201 KRW on PBOC easing and stimulus hopes
CNY.brief: The Chinese yuan trades steadily near 201 KRW as the PBOC supplies accommodative liquidity and firm daily fixings while investors track the rollout of fiscal stimulus measures.

GBP.headline: Pound tests 1,780 KRW as dollar softens amid BoE cut and budget caution
GBP.brief: Sterling tests 1,780 KRW supported by broader dollar softening, though expectations of further BoE rate cuts and fiscal caution ahead of the UK Autumn Budget cap rallies.

AUD.headline: Aussie dollar supported by steady RBA policy and commodity rebound
AUD.brief: The Australian dollar is anchored by the Reserve Bank of Australia's firm rate hold, tracking iron ore price gains and economic stimulus developments from China near 940 KRW.

CAD.headline: Loonie defends 950 KRW on crude oil rally despite BoC rate cut gap
CAD.brief: The Canadian dollar gains support from elevated crude oil prices amid Middle East tensions, helping cushion the yield gap created by the Bank of Canada's rate-cutting cycle.

CHF.headline: Swiss franc holds 1,610 KRW on safe-haven demand despite low SNB rates
CHF.brief: The Swiss franc maintains resilient safe-haven demand driven by Middle East geopolitical risks and European fiscal concerns, balancing the SNB's accommodative low-rate stance.

HKD.headline: Hong Kong dollar steady near 170 KRW within USD peg band
HKD.brief: The Hong Kong dollar trades calmly within its 7.75–7.85 peg band near 170 KRW, closely tracking Fed policy expectations and capital flows across Greater China equity markets.
